entry.title: New: Resolution 314 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF LABOR AND MATERIALS FOR A PLAYGROUND TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION

The donation from Kona Playgrounds Foundation and an anonymous party, with an estimated value of $45,000, would be utilized at the William Charles Lunalilo Playground in Kailua-Kona.
